pick.name: Canva Free (+ Gemini image generation)
pick.what: Templates and layout for YouTube thumbnails, LinkedIn carousels and banners; generate base art in the Gemini app
pick.why: Fastest template-to-thumbnail path; free tier now includes background remover and a monthly AI allowance; Gemini (owned) adds ~100 Nano Banana Pro images/day
pick.free_limits: Canva Free: 5 GB, about 20 AI uses/month shared across Standard/Premium tools (Canva help); Pro price unverified

alts.name: Gemini app image generation (Nano Banana Pro)
alts.what: Owned AI image generation and editing
alts.why: Best for custom base images and edits; text rendering is strong
alts.free_limits: AI Pro: 100 Nano Banana Pro + 1,000 Nano Banana images/day (Jan 2026)

alts.name: Photopea
alts.what: Free browser Photoshop clone with PSD support
alts.why: Best free pixel-level editing when Canva templates are not enough

candidates.name: Gemini image gen
candidates.verdict: Owned; use for the base image

candidates.name: Figma Free
candidates.verdict: Great for systematic design; not verified this pass

candidates.name: YouTube Test & Compare
candidates.verdict: Not an editor: use it to A/B the thumbnails once in YPP

decision: Generate the hero image in Gemini (owned), lay out text and brand in Canva Free, and A/B test on YouTube once eligible. Upgrade to Canva Pro only if you need brand kits and premium assets weekly.

verify.note: Canva own pricing/help: Free gets up to 20 AI uses/month in one shared pool (Standard OR Premium), NOT 200 Standard or 20 Premium; 200 is Canva Pro Premium-tier uses. eesel secondary blog wrong. Pro price not verified (pricing page 403).
